content.summary: Rice cakes move from dry sheet to coated bowl with one poached egg. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Heat is established before the first ingredient state change. + Each addition visibly contacts and remains part of one continuous food inventory. + Cooking states progress irreversibly from dry to softened to coated. + Transfer to the serving vessel preserves the completed food rather than replacing it. + A final garnish and steam hold prove a complete edible result.
quick_start.recommended_input: Ignite one induction ring beneath a shallow copper pan and establish one original dry rice-cake sheet above simmering broth. Add green herbs, red pepper oil and toasted seeds in three distinct contacts that remain accounted for. Place one soft poached egg on top and hold steam, sauce coating, complete bowl and clean serving edge together.

invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.

invariants.rule: Cooking states progress irreversibly from dry to softened to coated.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Cooking states progress irreversibly from dry to softened to coated."

invariants.rule: Transfer to the serving vessel preserves the completed food rather than replacing it.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Transfer to the serving vessel preserves the completed food rather than replacing it."

invariants.rule: A final garnish and steam hold prove a complete edible result.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "A final garnish and steam hold prove a complete edible result."
